D-001.threat: Request flooding: Attacker overwhelms {{targetName}} with excessive incoming requests
D-001.cause: No rate limiting or request throttling protecting {{targetName}} from high-volume input via {{sourceName}}
D-001.attack: Attacker sends a high volume of requests via the data flow, exhausting the processing capacity of {{targetName}}

D-002.threat: Response blocking: Attacker prevents {{sourceName}} from receiving responses from {{targetName}}
D-002.cause: No redundancy or timeout protection — {{sourceName}} depends on responses from {{targetName}} to continue operation
D-002.attack: Attacker disrupts or delays the response channel from {{targetName}}, causing {{sourceName}} to stall or fail
